name: r7c_self_relative_report_delay_3y_v1
units: calendar days relative to own prior-three same-season median
availability: First valid PIT per code/report uses max(real ann,f_ann)>=quarter end, never end as substitute. Strict next exchange trading day release; exact prior3 same-season firstPIT strictly earlier. Full date-only source history is read with cutoff filtering, so1700 panel warmup cannot truncate historical baselines. Historical arrival/vintage remains unverified.
missing_policy: Newest released report-period frontier wins; same release chooses greatest end; older delayed reports do not roll frontier back. Missing any exact baseline report => new stateNaN. Active exchange age0..59 only, age continues during suspension; t nontraded=>NaN. Invalid calendar/pre-end announcements cannot create events. No filling, skipping, or alternate windows.
resource_note: Engine empty fin_fields means all financial fields; one unused revenue compatibility prebuild field limits resource use. Compute reads only4 raw date/key columns plus traded mask; numeric revenue is never used. All date partitions deliberately retained for reproducible annual/prefix history.

spec.desc: An unexpectedly later completed financial disclosure relative to the same company's prior three same-season reports may reflect adverse information that continues to be incorporated after disclosure; weak negative prior.
spec.formula: a_p=min_valid_versions(max(ann,f_ann));L_p=caldays(a_p-end_p);B_p=median(L_p-4,L_p-8,L_p-12),all historical a<a_p;D=L-B;v=firstTD>a_p;F_t=D of greatest released reportend only for0<=TDage(t,v)<60 and traded.
spec.note: Single frozen weak negative candidate. Completed disclosure only; no waiting pressure. Float64 arithmetic and Engine/Store float32 serialization. Unchanged base8; fixed rank controls current L, historical same-season B, release Age0..59, report-season observed-level dummies (largest observed quarter reference), R2 earliness_mean4, R4 SUE, SUE acceleration, forecast_landing_gap. No deletion to rescue rank deficiency. Raw D=L-B has no independent third linear dimension.
